data.name: AI Agents Team Up in Shared Digital Workspaces
data.hook: Imagine handing a project to a team of specialized AI agents that divide tasks like real colleagues, while you oversee from the sidelines.

data.name: Startup Founder Talks More to AI Agents Than Human Team
data.hook: Greg Isenberg runs his 50-person startup across 12 countries, but these days he chats more with AI agents than colleagues. He calls it 'kinda dystopian' in a post detailing his elaborate AI workflow.

data.name: Glasshand Lets AI Agents Rent Real iPhones and Macs
data.hook: Imagine your AI agent tapping away on a real iPhone, booking an Uber or posting on Instagram just like you do every day. Trevor Keith's Glasshand makes that possible with physical devices in a data center.

data.name: AI Agents Could Collapse Economic Friction in Markets
data.hook: Picture concert tickets vanishing into AI agents the instant they go on sale, or flights rebooked endlessly for the lowest fare. That's the 'friction collapse' users are unpacking as AI reshapes everyday transactions.

data.name: Anthropic CEO Predicts AI to Eliminate Half of Entry-Level White-Collar Jobs in Five Years
data.hook: Dario Amodei sees AI taking over the routine tasks that launch careers in law, consulting, and finance. His warning paints a picture of young professionals facing a shrinking path to experience.

data.name: 1983 Automation Paper Echoes in AI Coding Debates
data.hook: A psychologist's 1983 warning about automation's hidden traps feels eerily spot-on as developers wrestle with trusting AI-generated code.

data.name: Debate Grows Over Vibe Coding's Limits in Software Development
data.hook: A simple React counter that barely increments exposes the pitfalls of 'vibe coding'—letting AI generate code with little review. What started as a fun shortcut now faces tough questions.

data.name: Corporate Push for AI Clashes with Worker Skepticism
data.hook: CEOs are mandating AI use for employees, even tying it to job security, while many workers push back amid fears of job loss and disempowerment.

data.name: Oumi Launches FAiE to Automate Custom AI Agent Building
data.hook: Imagine describing a task in plain words and getting a ready-to-use AI agent hours later. Oumi's new FAiE tool makes that real by handling the heavy engineering lift.

data.name: Grok Bot Users Hit Usage Limits Early Due to Cost Adjustments
data.hook: Michael Hyatt built a team of 24 bots to run his business smoothly, but after just five days, he slammed into his weekly cap—and racked up $272 in extra fees.

data.name: Notion Enables Shared Memory for AI Agents Across Tools
data.hook: Imagine switching from ChatGPT to Claude mid-project without losing a single note or decision. Notion's new update makes that seamless reality possible.

data.name: LangChain Adds Async Subagents for Responsive AI Agents
data.hook: Imagine an AI agent that keeps chatting with you while quietly handling big tasks in the background—no more awkward waits.

data.name: Engineers Warn Against Over-Relying on AI Coding Tools
data.hook: Software engineers worry that leaning too heavily on AI coding agents could dull their own skills over time. Anthropic's Addy Osmani laid out the risks in a detailed post that struck a chord.

data.name: AI Agents Reshape Software Development by Handling Code Reviews
data.hook: AI coding agents are now writing code that gets approved without humans reading every line, freeing developers to focus on bigger ideas.

data.name: Developers Debate Vibe Coding's Productivity Trap
data.hook: One engineer nailed it: vibe coding lets you feel productive while nothing actually ships. It's sparking raw clashes over AI's role in real software work.
